title: CustodyMusic - Skyfall
htmlContent:
CustodyMusic shares a brand new single "Skyfall". The single "Skyfall" is CustodyMusic latest release that brings a realism to the music that can’t be faked, as you hear in every line how much he thrives to be a large figure in the game, and with work like this he surely will be.

CustodyMusic is powerful on this latest record as he commanding in his flow and lyricism that is sharper than ever, as each line packs a punch to make it a record you can feel for every second. The music is supreme quality with the production having a smooth sound that moves in waves, that sets the stage perfectly, while the rhyming sends chills through on this record that doesn’t lose.
